panels.title: Zapytania DNS na godzinę wg urządzenia
panels.description: Liczba zapytań DNS w każdej godzinie, skumulowana po urządzeniach.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.hour_ts) AS INTEGER) AS time,
  CASE WHEN s.mac = 'unknown' THEN 'Nieznane urządzenie' ELSE COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, s.mac) END AS device,
  s.queries AS "Zapytania"
FROM dns_hourly_stats s
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = s.mac
WHERE s.hour_ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND s.hour_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY time, device
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.hour_ts) AS INTEGER) AS time,
  CASE WHEN s.mac = 'unknown' THEN 'Nieznane urządzenie' ELSE COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, s.mac) END AS device,
  s.queries AS "Zapytania"
FROM dns_hourly_stats s
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = s.mac
WHERE s.hour_ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND s.hour_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY time, device

panels.title: Odsetek zablokowanych zapytań
panels.description: Zapytania zablokowane przez AdGuard Home w wybranym okresie.

targets.queryText:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(blocked) / NULLIF(SUM(queries), 0) AS "Zablokowane"
FROM dns_hourly_stats
WHERE hour_ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND hour_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(blocked) / NULLIF(SUM(queries), 0) AS "Zablokowane"
FROM dns_hourly_stats
WHERE hour_ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND hour_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')

panels.title: Najczęściej odpytywane domeny
panels.description: Bez urządzeń osób w trybie „tylko statystyki”.

targets.queryText:
SELECT h.domain AS "Domena", SUM(h.queries) AS "Zapytania"
FROM dns_hourly h
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = h.mac
LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.id = d.person_id
WHERE COALESCE(p.privacy_mode, 'full') = 'full' AND h.hour_ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND h.hour_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY h.domain
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT h.domain AS "Domena", SUM(h.queries) AS "Zapytania"
FROM dns_hourly h
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = h.mac
LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.id = d.person_id
WHERE COALESCE(p.privacy_mode, 'full') = 'full' AND h.hour_ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND h.hour_ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY h.domain
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Nowe domeny
panels.description: Domeny odpytane po raz pierwszy przez dane urządzenie. Bez urządzeń osób w trybie „tylko statystyki”.

targets.queryText:

  CASE WHEN f.mac = 'unknown' THEN 'Nieznane urządzenie' ELSE COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, f.mac) END AS "Urządzenie",
  f.domain AS "Domena"
FROM domain_first_seen f
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = f.mac
LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.id = d.person_id
WHERE COALESCE(p.privacy_mode, 'full') = 'full' AND f.first_seen >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND f.first_seen <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
ORDER BY f.first_seen DESC
LIMIT 200
